```{r}
library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(mapgl)
library(tidyr)

# We don't need to pass credentials to googlesheets since the sheet is publicly available.
gs4_deauth()

# Two files to gather and bind:
# - google sheets with lecture series
# - google sheets with our events

our_events <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wczoSH6H9OYJNLDQaFZ6Vx97DywwtIavCawnW9a4eDw/edit?gid=0#gid=0"
)|>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date)
  ) |> 
  select(type = type, date, title = event_name, extra_info = location, long, lat, link)

lectures <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-CxROgJQ3MKTpunj429rvh7Q-_XVnnRbK4-HjaNazFI/edit?gid=679046529#gid=679046529"
) |> 
  # This google sheets has some custom delimiter rows, so we only keep the rows that actually
  # correspond to lecture series.
  filter(grepl(" ", Name), !is.na(Title)) |>
  unnest(Date) |>
  mutate(
    type = "Lecture Series",
    date = as.Date(Date),
    extra_info = if_else(
      !is.na(Affiliation),
      paste0(Name, " (", Affiliation, ")"),
      Name
    )
  ) |>
  # Only show time for future lectures
  mutate(time = if_else(date < Sys.Date(), NA, `Time (UTC)`)) |>
  select(type, date, time, title = Title, extra_info, link = `Youtube link`)

events <- bind_rows(our_events, lectures)

today <- Sys.Date()

future_events <- events |>
  filter(date >= today) |>
  arrange(date) |>
  # Future lecture series shouldn't link to youtube but to our "Lecture series" page instead
  mutate(
    link = if_else(type == "Lecture Series", "../lecture-series", link)
  )

past_events <- events |>
  filter(date < today) |>
  arrange(desc(date))

# Helper function to add a custom CSS class to a card depending on the type of event.
# This is necessary to give different colours to cards for instance.
type_to_css <- function(type) {
  switch(
    tolower(type),
    "workshop" = "event-workshop",
    "other" = "event-other",
    "hackathon" = "event-hackathon",
    "lecture series" = "event-lecture",
    stop("The event type should be one of the types above.")
  )
}

# Helper function to create the filter buttons at the top of the page to select the type of
# events that we want to see.
render_filter <- function() {
  # This is hardcoded because it determines the order of filter buttons (we want "Other" to be last)
  categories <- c("Lecture Series", "Workshop", "Other")
  buttons <- sapply(categories, function(category) {
    sprintf(
      '<button class="event-filter-btn" data-filter="%s">%s<i class="bi bi-check"></i></button>',
      category,
      category
    )
  })
  knitr::asis_output(paste0(
    '<div class="event-filter-bar">\n',
    paste(buttons, collapse = "\n"),
    '\n</div>'
  ))
}

# Helper function to render the cards for all past or all future events.
#
# "df" is a dataframe that contains all past events or all future events.
render_cards <- function(df) {
  parts <- '<div class="event-grid">'
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    row <- df[i, ]
    css <- type_to_css(row$type)

    date_str <- format(row$date, "%B %d, %Y")

    # The time is only present for future lecture series
    time_str <- if (is.na(row$time)) {
      ""
    } else {
      paste0(" · ", row$time)
    }

    # Create the button if needed (some future events don't have a link yet)
    has_link <- !is.na(row$link) && nzchar(row$link)
    has_youtube_link <- has_link && grepl("youtube", row$link)
    if (row$type == "Lecture Series") {
      button <- if (has_youtube_link) {
        sprintf(
          '<a class="event-card-btn" href="%s" target="_blank"><i class="bi bi-youtube"></i>&nbsp;Watch on YouTube</a>',
          row$link
        )
      } else if (has_link) {
        '<a class="event-card-btn" href="/training/lecture-series/"><i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i>&nbsp;More info</a>'
      } else {
        ""
      }
    }
    if (row$type != "Lecture Series") {
      button <- if (has_link) {
        sprintf(
          '<a class="event-card-btn" href="%s" target="_blank"><i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i>&nbsp;More info</a>',
          row$link
        )
      } else {
      ""
      }
    }

    # Add a custom class for CSS
    button <- if (nchar(button) > 0) {
      sprintf('<div class="event-actions">%s</div>', button)
    } else {
      ""
    }

    card_div <- sprintf(
      '<div class="event-card %s"><span class="event-tag">%s</span><h3>%s</h3><p class="event-date">%s %s <br> %s</p>%s</div>',
      css,
      row$type,
      row$title,
      date_str,
      time_str,
      row$extra_info,
      button
    )
    item <- sprintf(
      '<div class="event-item" data-type="%s">%s</div>',
      row$type,
      card_div
    )
    parts <- c(parts, item)
  }
  parts <- c(parts, "</div>")

  # We always add a (hidden) <p> that indicates that our filters didn't return anything.
  # We use JavaScript below to show this text if the list of events is empty.
  parts <- c(
    parts,
    '<p class="event-empty-msg" style="display:none"><em>No events match the selected filters.</em></p>'
  )
  knitr::asis_output(paste(parts, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

All events are shown by default. Select one or more types to filter:
```{r}
render_filter()
```

<!-- Some raw HTML to determine whether we show the events as a grid or as a map. -->

Select the view mode:

```{=html}
<div class="view-toggle-bar">
  <button class="view-toggle-btn active" data-view="list"><i class="bi bi-list-ul"></i> List</button>
  <button class="view-toggle-btn" data-view="map"><i class="bi bi-map"></i> Map</button>
</div>
```

::: {#view-list}

## Future events

```{r}
render_cards(future_events)
```

## Past events

```{r}
render_cards(past_events)
```

:::

::: {#view-map style="display:none"}

```{r}
# The map only shows future events.
map_dat <- events |>
  filter(date >= today) |>
  filter(!is.na(long) & !is.na(lat)) |>
  mutate(
    date = format(as.Date(date), format = "%d %B %Y"),
    essential_info = paste0(
      "<b>", type, "</b>", "<br>", title, "<br>", date, "<br>", extra_info
    )
  ) |>
  # If two events happen in the same place, we aggregate their info so that
  # the tooltip shows all events and not just the last one.
  mutate(
    essential_info = paste(essential_info, collapse = "<br><hr>"), 
    .by = c(lat, long)
  ) |>
  distinct(essential_info, type, lat, long) |> 
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

maplibre(projection = "mercator", zoom = 0, height = "500px") |>
  add_fullscreen_control(position = "top-left") |>
  add_navigation_control() |>
  add_circle_layer(
    id = "poi-layer",
    source = map_dat,
    # The colour specified here doesn't matter. We use some JavaScript below to read the 
    # colors defined in our SCSS file so that the colour matches between the grid view and 
    # the map view. 
    # This way, we only need to define the colours once in the SCSS file.
    circle_color = "#575756",
    circle_radius = 8,
    circle_stroke_color = "#ffffff",
    circle_stroke_width = 2,
    circle_opacity = 0.8,
    tooltip = "essential_info",
    hover_options = list(circle_radius = 12, circle_color = "#ffff99")
  ) |>
  # When the user loads this page, we grab the colours defined in the SCSS file and
  # apply them to each point depending on the event type.
  htmlwidgets::onRender(
    "
    function(el, x) {
      // 'this' is the widget factory result; try getMap() then .map
      var map = this.getMap ? this.getMap() : this.map;
      if (!map) return;
      // Color the circles per event type using the --event-color-* CSS
      // variables defined in styles.scss, so the map matches the event cards.
      var applyColors = function() {
        if (!map.getLayer('poi-layer')) { map.once('idle', applyColors); return; }
        var css = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
        var c = function(name) { return css.getPropertyValue(name).trim(); };
        map.setPaintProperty('poi-layer', 'circle-color', [
          'match', ['get', 'type'],
          'Workshop', c('--event-color-workshop'),
          'Other', c('--event-color-other'),
          'Hackathon', c('--event-color-hackathon'),
          'Lecture Series', c('--event-color-lecture'),
          '#575756'
        ]);
      };
      // wait for the style + layers to be ready before exposing the reference
      var store = function() { window._palaeoMap = map; applyColors(); };
      if (map.isStyleLoaded()) store();
      else map.once('load', store);
    }
  "
  )
```

:::


<!-- 
Custom JavaScript that:

1) applies the filters about the event types we want to display;
1) either shows the map or the grid.

-->
```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  // View toggle (list / map)
  const toggleBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.view-toggle-btn');
  const listView = document.getElementById('view-list');
  const mapView = document.getElementById('view-map');

  toggleBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      toggleBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      this.classList.add('active');
      if (this.dataset.view === 'list') {
        listView.style.display = '';
        mapView.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        listView.style.display = 'none';
        mapView.style.display = '';
        // Maplibre initialises at 0×0 when hidden; resize after display
        setTimeout(function () {
          if (window._palaeoMap) window._palaeoMap.resize();
        }, 10);
      }
    });
  });

  // Event type filter
  const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.event-filter-btn');

  function getActiveFilters() {
    return Array.from(filterBtns)
      .filter(b => b.classList.contains('active'))
      .map(b => b.dataset.filter);
  }

  function updateListVisibility() {
    const active = getActiveFilters();
    // No filter selected => show all events
    const showAll = active.length === 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-type]').forEach(el => {
      el.style.display = (showAll || active.includes(el.dataset.type)) ? '' : 'none';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.event-grid').forEach(grid => {
      const hasVisible = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('[data-type]'))
        .some(el => el.style.display !== 'none');
      const msg = grid.nextElementSibling;
      if (msg && msg.classList.contains('event-empty-msg')) {
        grid.style.display = hasVisible ? '' : 'none';
        msg.style.display = hasVisible ? 'none' : '';
      }
    });
  }

  function updateMapFilter() {
    if (!window._palaeoMap) return;
    const activeTypes = getActiveFilters();
    if (activeTypes.length === 0) {
      // No filter selected => show all events
      window._palaeoMap.setFilter('poi-layer', null);
    } else {
      window._palaeoMap.setFilter('poi-layer', ['in', ['get', 'type'], ['literal', activeTypes]]);
    }
  }

  filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      this.classList.toggle('active');
      updateListVisibility();
      updateMapFilter();
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
